label: Regular-open priority direction control
paraphrase: The existing complete Boolean regular-open gunk interpretation has an injective descending proper-part chain from each positive region; neither strict parthood nor its full converse is well-founded. The same downward sequence is not an upward grounding chain. A different designated-greatest-region star on that same carrier is well-founded and has a unique relative source, while omitting some converse-parthood edges. The Boolean region algebra has no Mathlib atoms; Set Bool is both Mathlib atomic and atomistic. No actual gunk, power, being or metaphysical possibility is asserted.
